main_text.l: גנב Furatus est, Abduxit, Subtraxit, Surripuit furtim: Præt. גָּנַבְתָּ אֶת־אֱלֹהָי Furatus es Deos meos, Genes.31. 30. Partic. Præter. גָּנוּב Furtivum, Gen.30.33. Plural. מַיִם גְּנֻבִים Aquæ furtivæ, Prov.19. v.17. Fœminինum cum ' paragogico, juxta R.Salom. גְּנֻבַתִּי Furto sublatum, Gen.31.39. Vide simile infra in מלא. Niph. Futur. יִגָּנֵב Furto ablatum erit, Exod.22.12. Pih. Præter. Plural. Constructi. מְגַנְּבֵי Suffuratores, qui suffurantur, Jerem.23.v.30. Futur. וַיְגַנֵּב אֶת־לֵב Et suffurabatur cor, 2.Sam.15.6. Pyh. Infinit. cum Præter. גְּנֹב גְּנֻבָתִּי Furando furto ablatus sum, Genes.40.15. Fut. וְאֵלַי דָּבָר יִגָּנֵב Et apud me verbum erat furtivum, Job.4.11. Absconditum, Clandestinum. Hithp. Futur. וַיִּתְגַּנֵּב Et furtim subtraxit se, 2.Sam.19.3.
גַּנָּב m. Fur: כִּבְשַׁת גַּנָּב Secundum pudorem furis, Jer.2. v.26. Plur. חֲבֵרֵי גַּנָּבִים Socii furum, Jesa.1.23.
גְּנֵבָה f. Furtum, Exod.22.4. Aff. בִּגְנֻבָתוֹ Cum furto suo, verf.3.
גָּנַז m. Thesaurus: Gazæ: Plur. Const. אֶל־גַּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ In Thesauros regis, Esth.3 9. Chald. בֵּית גְּנָזַיָּא In domo gazarum vel thesaurorum, Esr.5.17.
גִּנְזָךְ m. Gazophylacium: Plural. cum Aff. וּגְנִזְכֵי Et Gazophylaciorum ejus, 1.Paral.28.11. R.Sal. scribit, esse Lo-cum, in quo thesauri sacri asservantur. Formæ אִרְנָּז.

גָּנַן Protexit, Obtexit: Construitur cum עַל. Præter. וּגַנּוֹתִי עַל הָעִיר Et protegam supra urbem hanc, 2.Reg.20.6. Infinit. גָּנוֹן Protegendo, Jesa.31. v.5. Hiph. Futur. יָגֵן עֲלֵיהֶם Proteget eos, Zach.9.15.
גַּן Hortus: quod sepio Protegi soleat, Genes.2.8. Aff. לְגַנִּי In hortum meum, Cant.5.1. Plural. מַעְיַן גַּנִּים Fons hortorum, Cant.4.15.
גַּנָּה f. Idem, Jesa.1.30. Constr. גִּנַּת Cant.6.10. Plural.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are transcribed from the scan at small size and may contain errors; the forms in the Hebrew headwords (גנב, גנן, גן) and the Hebrew in the entry for מלא are uncertain. The word "Fœminինum" contains a stray Devanagari-like form and should read "Fœminínum"; the Hebrew in the entry for "Thesaurus" (אִרְנָּז) and "Gazophylacium" are uncertain. The "Plural." at the foot continues the last entry and its Hebrew is not shown in the scan. The Latin abbreviations "Genes." and "Gen." appear as printed.
